qa_pairs.question: Which has a higher torque specification: M8 hex screws or M8 Torx bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: M8 hex screws have a higher torque specification at 25 Nm compared to M8 Torx bolts at 22 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M10 hex screws and M10 Torx bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: M10 hex screws require 49 Nm while M10 Torx bolts require 43 Nm, a difference of 6 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which fasteners are used for connecting the transmission to the engine?
qa_pairs.answer: Both hex screws and Torx bolts in sizes M8, M10, and M12

qa_pairs.question: What manual section covers manual transmission specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-1 Manual Transmission, subsection 23 00 Transmission in general
